title: tampaBayOpenData 0.1.0
text: Includes checked catalog 52 ArcGIS layers Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Hillsborough County, Pinellas County, Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council. catalog policy records selection criteria, source limits, candidate decisions, topic coverage. catalog selective; mirror publisher data. Exports 15 consistently named tbod_* functions discovery, inspection, retrieval, download. Twelve unprefixed development names removed first release. See API migration guide replacements. Searches six configured public ArcGIS organizations well offline checked catalog. Catalog searches support jurisdiction, publisher, validation status, geometry, topic, category, item-date filters. Live scans default 25 service items per organization report truncation, issues, failed portals. bounded scan can miss matches. Adds tbod_discover() another public ArcGIS sharing REST root, FeatureServer, MapServer, layer URL. Queryable MapServer layers FeatureServer layers use retrieval API. Discovered rows retain live item dates, tags, categories; checked matches retain package IDs, scope, terms. Direct URLs not_checked status. Compares current fields, object ID, geometry, CRS, endpoint metadata saved schemas checked retrieval downloads. Added fields changed aliases warn; removed type-changed fields, geometry CRS changes, vanished layers stop retrieval. tbod_schema() tbod_check_schema() expose metadata drift report. Retrieves tibbles optional sf results field selection, ArcGIS filters, ordering, row limits, source provenance. Count object-ID checks catch missing, duplicate, unexpected pages. Eligible small previews can use subset manifest; complete retrieval checks full matching manifest. Deliberate subsets remain marked incomplete. Sources can still change record attributes requests. Parses declared ArcGIS field types, dates, geometry, spatial references. Date fields unknown time-zone semantics remain raw milliseconds, except UTC editor-tracking fields identified metadata. Request operation timeouts bound live work. Adds resumable RDS chunk downloads. Resuming rechecks current schema full record membership, verifies saved checksums provenance, skips completed chunks. Atomic writes exclusive directory lock protect progress; live record attributes may differ across chunks sessions. Moves Tampa parks fire-stations dedicated services matching source IDs. current fire-station fields unqualified (example, NAME); older joined GIS.GovServiceInfo.* fields unavailable. Terms updated replacement endpoints. source data labeled CC0 package. Adds offline catalog schema checks, bounded twice-weekly live checks across six publishers, separate manual integration suite. validation record gives dated evidence; live services can change afterward. CI actions pinned verified commits. Rejects malformed metadata query responses, duplicate JSON keys, conflicting CRS identifiers, invalid numeric object IDs. HTTP requests follow redirects; retry waits capped 30 seconds, accepted responses 50 MiB, JSON nesting 64 containers. JSON parsed literal text, spatial WKT must inline. package requires httr2 1.2.3 later jsonlite 1.6.0 later; older native curl builds still need decompression security updates. Credits nycOpenData design inspiration. ArcGIS client code independently implemented.
